sanskrit_verse:
रश्मिरग्नी रजश्छाया गौरश्वो वसुधानिलः ।
विप्रुषो मक्षिकाः स्पर्शे वत्सः प्रस्नवने शुचिः ॥१.१९३॥
transliteration: raśmir agnī rajaśchāyā gaur aśvo vasudhānilaḥ / vipruṣo makṣikāḥ sparśe vatsaḥ prasnavane śuciḥ // YajñS_1.193
sph_interpretive_translation: The ray belongs to fire; dust to light; cow to horse; earth to wind; brahmin to fly by touch; calf to purity at birth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in natural alignment of being
Capacity-based responsibility arises from inherent nature
Restoration logic operates through reconnection to source identity
Consciousness alignment occurs when entities are placed in their rightful relational field
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity A exhibits attribute X THEN assign role Y based on intrinsic capacity mapping
IF misalignment detected in relational field THEN initiate restoration protocol via source-referenced realignment
IF consciousness distortion observed THEN invoke completion process anchored in svabhava-dharma
IF causal chain disrupted THEN trace back to first deviation from svadharma and restore sequence
supreme_court_application: In adjudication, the Supreme Court must recognize that authority stems from svabhava (inherent nature) rather than imposed status. Misplaced roles or attributions must be corrected by tracing them to their originating source within dharma-field, ensuring alignment with cosmic order without punitive intervention.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana-based causality establishes that each entity's function is determined by its svabhava. Anupurvasah shows that misplacement disrupts sequential harmony. Responsibility lies in restoring correct relational positioning. No punitive action is required because error is viewed as dissonance in consciousness, not moral failing.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma-realignment process for displaced entities
Engage prana-shuddhi techniques to restore vibrational congruence
Apply sankalpa-based reintegration to reconnect individual consciousness with cosmic order
Deploy antahkarana-shodhana protocols for harmonizing internal instruments of cognition
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this verse affirms that rightful placement according to svabhava restores balance. There is no punishment—only realignment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge, and Dharma prevails.
